description: From the lane at night, the Iglesia de Santiago de Peñalba shows its slate roofs, horseshoe arches and a small crossing lantern. The bells hang in a free-standing western espadaña, an open stone gable, not in a closed square tower with a hipped roof. Slate houses of the village step along the Montes Aquilanos.
